notes.title: Release - v1.0
notes.content:
The game has been released and will no longer be in early access.

Patch notes:

- Languages supported: English, German, Chinese, Russian, Polish
- Added Language menu to settings
- Minor UI updates


The game will now no longer be in active development...

notes.title: Big Performance Patch- 23.06.24 - v0.2
notes.content:
Patchnotes

This patch brings some major updates to the game.


Additions:


- Steam Cloud for Savegame enabled

Settings Menu:
- Graphics menu with presets: Low, Medium, High, Epic, Cinematic
- Audio menu


Updates:

Performance:
- Update to Unreal Engine 5.4
- Major performance increase due to reduction of texture size
- Decrease in Game size: 4GB -> 800MB

Gameplay:
- Updates to Prozedural Generated Trees & Grass surrounding the street
- Fixed Score system (this time for real)
- Audio Queue for jumping changed




If you have any problem or want to leave any feedback, feel free to join the discord:
